name: 20903 · Silver Spring, MD
findings: ZIP 20903 (Silver Spring) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20903 (Silver Spring) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20903 (Silver Spring) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
